"""Command-line interface for PropScan."""

import click
import json
import sys
from tabulate import tabulate
from colorama import init, Fore, Style

from .core import PropScan


init(autoreset=True)


def format_table_output(results):
    """Format results as a table."""
    if not results:
        click.echo(f"{Fore.GREEN}✓ No proprietary software found!")
        return
